events.verdict: Doncic (LAL) initiates contact to Flagg's (DAL) front that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Marshall (DAL) and Smart (LAL) come together during the pick and marginal contact occurs as Smart attempts to release away from the contact.
LaRavia (LAL) is firming up in Flagg's (DAL) path when marginal contact occurs with Flagg's side during the off-ball screen.
James (LAL) jumps toward the rebound when incidental contact occurs with Washington Jr. (DAL) as Smart (LAL) is already retrieving the loose ball.
Washington (DAL) is bumped into Smart (LAL) as he is returning to the ground following his shot attempt. This contact is incidental.
LaRavia (LAL) maintains verticality as he defends Williams' (DAL) shot attempt.
James (LAL) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Smart (LAL) directly contests Williams' (DAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Williams' hand after the release.
Williams (DAL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Marshall (DAL) reaches in and initiates contact with Doncic's (LAL) arm which affects his SQBR.
Doncic (LAL) attempts to go for the steal and initiates contact with Marshall's (DAL) arm and lower body, affecting Marshall's SQBR.
Doncic (LAL) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two steps before releasing the shot attempt.
Marshall (DAL) initiates contact with Doncic (LAL), who has established a legal guarding position in his path prior to the contact.
Christie (DAL) directly contests Doncic's (LAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Doncic's hand after the release.
LaRavia (LAL) maintains verticality as he defends Marshall's (DAL) shot attempt.
